mapper.select: SELECT id, lost_id, found_id, score, engine, degraded_reason, prompt_version, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reason, lost_hash, found_hash, lost_unlocked_at, found_unlocked_at, lost_unlock_note, found_unlock_note, lost_confirmed_at, found_confirmed_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_pair_score WHERE lost_id = #{lostId} AND found_id = #{foundId}

SELECT id, lost_id, found_id, score, engine, degraded_reason, prompt_version, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reason, lost_hash, found_hash, lost_unlocked_at, found_unlocked_at, lost_unlock_note, found_unlock_note, lost_confirmed_at, found_confirmed_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_pair_score WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_pair_score (lost_id, found_id, score, engine, degraded_reason, prompt_version, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reason, lost_hash, found_hash) VALUES (#{lostId}, #{foundId}, #{score}, #{engine}, #{degradedReason}, #{promptVersion}, #{latencyMs}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{reason}, #{lostHash}, #{foundHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), engine = VALUES(engine), degraded_reason = VALUES(degraded_reason), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version), latency_ms = VALUES(latency_ms), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), reason = VALUES(reason), lost_hash = VALUES(lost_hash), found_hash = VALUES(found_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT id, lost_id, found_id, score, engine, degraded_reason, prompt_version, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reason, lost_hash, found_hash, lost_unlocked_at, found_unlocked_at, lost_unlock_note, found_unlock_note, lost_confirmed_at, found_confirmed_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_pair_score WHERE engine = 'LOCAL_KEYWORD' AND updated_at < #{updatedBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_pair_score WHERE (lost_id = #{recordId} OR found_id = #{recordId}) AND engine = 'LOCAL_KEYWORD'

SELECT id, lost_id, found_id, score, engine, degraded_reason, prompt_version, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reason, lost_hash, found_hash, lost_unlocked_at, found_unlocked_at, lost_unlock_note, found_unlock_note, lost_confirmed_at, found_confirmed_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_pair_score WHERE lost_id = #{recordId} OR found_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pair_score SET status = 'CONTACTED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE t_pair_score SET status = 'IGNORED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('NEW', 'CONTACTED')

UPDATE t_pair_score
lost_confirmed_at = COALESCE(lost_confirmed_at, #{at}),
found_confirmed_at = COALESCE(found_confirmed_at, #{at}),
status = CASE WHEN lost_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND found_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'CONTACTED' END
WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('NEW', 'CONTACTED')
UPDATE t_pair_score SET lost_unlock_note = NULL, lost_unlocked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_pair_score SET found_unlock_note = NULL, found_unlocked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
